item.title: Mitsubishi Shipbuilding Delivers Training Ship
item.description: Mitsubishi Shipbuilding has delivered the Wakashio Maru, a training ship for National Institute of Technology, Toyama College in Japan.This is the first replacement ship for the school since 1995 and the first ship Mitsubishi Shipbuilding has built for the school.
